subject: Sent the codes from two R files into one R console

messages.author: 91f10f3648638905
messages.subject: Sent the codes from two R files into one R console
parts:
Dear Jakson,

I need to sent the codes from two R files (both edited by using Vim) into one R console. Do you know how to do this?

(I have been using Vim-R-plugin over 7 years. It is aaawesome. Thank you for your contribution!!)

Best,
Jeff

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Sent the codes from two R files into one R console
parts:
Dear Jeff,

You can start R from one R file and then send code to the same R console from all R files that you open in Vim. You may use :e or :tabnew or :split to start editing another file.

Best,

Jakson
